dast.demoSolution0: Set a restrictive Content-Security-Policy response header.
dast.demoSolution1: Set HttpOnly and Secure flags on session cookies.

dast.demoSolution3: Encode output for its context and validate untrusted input.
dast.demoSolution4: Use parameterized queries and avoid SQL string concatenation.
